_about: The curated passive-voice participle wordlist (SPEC docs/spec/doc-lint-tool.md 2.5).
Passive voice is a candidate WARNING, not a shipped error. The style standard 4.2
lists it as a review prompt. A human keeps a passive form that reads better, so the
tool never fails a build on it.
The detector is the curated 'be' plus participle wordlist route the retext-passive
plugin uses (SPEC 2.5). This file is the participle half. The rule anchors on a
participle from this list, then looks back a short window for a 'be' form (am, is,
are, was, were, be, been, being), so 'was completed' or 'is generated' flags but an
active 'the worker completed the job' does not.
The list holds eventive participles common in the docs. It leaves out a participle
that reads mostly as a plain adjective after 'be' ('is ready', 'is required', 'is
open'), because that use is stative, not passive, and would over-flag. Precision is
moderate by design (SPEC 2.5): the list catches its entries, misses a participle not
on it, and may still over-flag a stative use of a listed word. The fixture corpus
(SPEC 6) sets the acceptance bar. Grow the list as a new false negative appears; drop
a word that over-flags in real docs. The inline disable directive (SPEC 6, #821) is
the escape hatch for an unavoidable false positive.
